locale: Public English listings, mostly United States
method: Opened Google Play games landing page and verified each candidate through a public Google Play listing. No APKs or protected assets obtained.
limits: Session duration, return motivation, adaptation feasibility and effort are design estimates, not measured player analytics. Controls labeled inferred need hands-on confirmation. Catalog is research, not a playable inventory.

entries.name: Subway Surfers
entries.core_mechanic: Three-lane obstacle runner with jumping and sliding.
entries.return_hypothesis: Distance mastery, collectible routes and fresh obstacle patterns.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: pseudo-3D lane projection avoids a full 3D world.
entries.original_adaptation: Hand-drawn courier dodges repair carts and low beams; route coins reward risky lanes.
entries.implementation_brief: Guarantee at least one traversable route; test lane change, jump, slide, pickup, collision and restart.

entries.name: Shadow Fight 2
entries.core_mechanic: 2D martial-arts duel with attacks, equipment and bosses.
entries.controls: Touch movement and attack buttons; arrows plus attack/block in adaptation.
entries.return_hypothesis: Learning opponent tells and mastering attack spacing.
entries.difficulty: Windups, recovery, range and enemy counterattacks.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: 2D state machines and explicit hitboxes; animation is the largest cost.
entries.original_adaptation: Original scrap silhouettes; light/heavy attacks, held guard, knockback and readable AI.
entries.implementation_brief: Attack must hit once; guard reduces valid front damage; test opponent victory, player defeat and recovery locks.

entries.name: Hill Climb Racing
entries.core_mechanic: Terrain driving with vehicle balance, tricks and finite fuel.
entries.controls: Gas/brake hold controls; two touch pedals in adaptation.
entries.return_hypothesis: Improved distance and learning when to accelerate or brake.
entries.difficulty: Slope torque, rollover risk and fuel management.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: constrained wheel/terrain simulation with fixed substeps.
entries.original_adaptation: Build a wobbly scrap buggy; fuel cans create route decisions and flips carry risk.
entries.implementation_brief: Exercise hill collision, wheel contact, accelerating/braking, pickup, fuel exhaustion and roof impact.

entries.name: Temple Run
entries.core_mechanic: Chase runner with turns, jumps, slides and collection.
entries.controls: Swipe turns/jump/slide; tilt for lateral movement in source family.
entries.return_hypothesis: Distance records and recognizing obstacle sequences.
entries.difficulty: Correct turns at junctions plus rapid obstacle responses.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: route segments and projected track, independent from lane runner.
entries.original_adaptation: Escape a crumbling reactor corridor; mandatory junction choices distinguish it from Metro.
entries.implementation_brief: Test left/right junction deadlines, jumping gaps, ducking beams and fair spawn spacing.

entries.name: Fruit Ninja®
entries.core_mechanic: Slice tossed objects, chain combos and avoid hazards.
entries.controls: Swipe through objects; mouse drag in adaptation.
entries.return_hypothesis: Combos, precision and a better score.
entries.difficulty: Separating safe objects from hazards while paths overlap.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: swept segment-circle collision and ballistic spawns.
entries.original_adaptation: Slice flying power cells while avoiding unstable red cores; no borrowed fruit/branding.
entries.implementation_brief: A slice crossing an object between frames must count once; hazard strike and missed-object limit must fail.

entries.name: Jetpack Joyride
entries.core_mechanic: Hold-to-fly runner through lasers, missiles and collectibles.
entries.controls: One-touch hold to rise/release to fall.
entries.return_hypothesis: Route mastery, survival distance and collectible patterns.
entries.difficulty: Vertical inertia and predicting moving hazards.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: 2D velocity integration and warning telegraphs.
entries.original_adaptation: Redrawn test pilot flies through original lab obstacle sets; missiles telegraph before launch.
entries.implementation_brief: Test lift/fall, ceiling clamp, coin pickup, laser collision and guided-missile warning time.

entries.name: Crossy Road
entries.core_mechanic: Grid hopping through traffic, railways and rivers.
entries.controls: Tap forward and swipe sideways; four arrows in adaptation.
entries.return_hypothesis: New layouts and an extra safe row.
entries.difficulty: Traffic timing, moving logs and pressure against waiting forever.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: tile coordinates plus continuous vehicle motion.
entries.original_adaptation: Cross paint roads, scrap trains and conveyor rivers with original creatures.
entries.implementation_brief: No generated row may be wholly impossible; test moving support, drowning, traffic collision and score only on new rows.

entries.name: Angry Birds 2
entries.core_mechanic: Aim a slingshot projectile to knock down enemy structures.
entries.controls: Drag backward to aim, release to launch.
entries.return_hypothesis: Efficient solutions, different shots and collapse chains.
entries.difficulty: Trajectory planning and selecting weak structural points.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: small rigid-body world with bounded debris.
entries.original_adaptation: Launch scrap balls at unstable cardboard robot forts with material-dependent break thresholds.
entries.implementation_brief: Validate drag strength, gravity arc, impact damage, collapse and finite-shot failure.

entries.name: Cut the Rope
entries.core_mechanic: Cut supporting ropes to deliver an object through a physics puzzle.
entries.controls: Swipe across ropes; numbered rope buttons also provided in adaptation.
entries.return_hypothesis: Trying a cleaner cut order and collecting optional sparks.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: distance constraints and swept rope cuts.
entries.original_adaptation: Swing a battery into a hungry reactor; original anchors, gates and geometry.
entries.implementation_brief: Release must preserve momentum; test correct delivery, premature cuts, floor miss and restart.

entries.name: Geometry Dash Lite
entries.core_mechanic: One-touch obstacle platforming synchronized with rhythm.
entries.controls: Tap/Space to jump; held input can buffer jump in adaptation.
entries.return_hypothesis: Learning a readable obstacle course and improving completion.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: authored beat-relative obstacle placement and fixed-step collision.
entries.original_adaptation: Paint waveform course with original metronome music, jump arcs and checkpoint-free short rounds.
entries.implementation_brief: Test buffered jump, ground contact, spike collision, course completion and no dependence on wall-clock sound timing.

entries.name: Doodle Jump
entries.core_mechanic: Automatic jumping up platforms with moving or fragile surfaces.
entries.controls: Source listing: tilt left/right and tap to shoot; adaptation uses touch halves or arrows.
entries.return_hypothesis: Higher altitude and exploiting platform routes.
entries.difficulty: Lateral landing alignment and changing platform types.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: downward platform crossing checks plus vertical camera.
entries.original_adaptation: Armored jumper climbs rooftop ledges; wind and crumbling platforms add original route choices.
entries.implementation_brief: Test auto-bounce, moving platform landing, camera tracking, height score and falling below camera.

entries.name: Flappy Bird
entries.core_mechanic: Tap flight through pipes and obstacles; current listing has Classic and Quest modes.
entries.return_hypothesis: One more gate and increasingly consistent control.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: simple integration and forgiving circle/rectangle collision.
entries.original_adaptation: Original cape glider crosses ink arches; this is a longer scored run distinct from existing three-gate Flappy Bonus.
entries.implementation_brief: Test flap impulse, gate score once, gap collision, bounds and restart.

entries.name: Stick Hero
entries.core_mechanic: Hold to extend a bridge, release it across a gap.
entries.return_hypothesis: Estimating the next distance and hitting perfect centers.
entries.difficulty: Bridge too short or too long.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: explicit growth/fall/walk phases and measurable support.
entries.original_adaptation: Grow telescoping scrap planks between rooftop chimneys; gaps and landing widths vary.
entries.implementation_brief: Test hold length, unsupported misses on both sides, walking and consecutive platform transitions.

entries.core_mechanic: Slide equal numbered tiles together; each tile merges once per move.
entries.controls: Four swipes or arrows; Undo/Reset controls in adaptation.
entries.return_hypothesis: Tactical board planning and larger combinations.
entries.difficulty: Avoiding a full board while preserving merge lanes.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: deterministic grid compression and validated move/spawn rules.
entries.original_adaptation: Reactor energy board with a short target and optional continued play; original artwork.
entries.implementation_brief: Test directional moves, one merge per tile, invalid move creates no tile, undo, target completion and blocked-board failure.

entries.name: Plants vs. Zombies™
entries.core_mechanic: Lane defense with limited resources, production and enemy waves.
entries.controls: Select unit then tap a lane tile; resource pickups.
entries.return_hypothesis: Building a better defense and responding to varied waves.
entries.difficulty: Placement opportunity cost, resource supply and armored enemies.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: bounded 3-lane simulation; avoid replicating source units or stages.
entries.original_adaptation: Deploy battery generators, bolt turrets and barricades against original rooftop machines.
entries.implementation_brief: Test spending rejection, generation, cooldowns, projectile hits, waves, unit destruction and base breach.

entries.name: Pou
entries.core_mechanic: Care for a virtual pet through food, cleaning, play and customization.
entries.controls: Tap/drag care items; numbered keyboard actions in adaptation.
entries.return_hypothesis: Expression, care feedback and trying playful interactions.
entries.difficulty: Balancing several needs rather than a twitch obstacle.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: deterministic need rates and bounded local state.
entries.original_adaptation: A tiny friendly reactor needs fuel, polishing and play; complete a short care request without real-time neglect penalties.
entries.implementation_brief: Each action affects a different need; test cooldowns, overfeeding tradeoff, request completion and timeout. No forced offline decay.

entries.name: Stack
entries.core_mechanic: Place moving slabs; overhang trims the next platform.
entries.return_hypothesis: A taller, cleaner tower.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: rectangle overlap, camera and slab travel.
entries.original_adaptation: Build uneven cardboard towers; perfect drops restore a little width.
entries.implementation_brief: Different from Brake Check: spatial overlap changes all later moves. Test trimming, zero overlap and camera rise.

entries.name: Helix Jump
entries.core_mechanic: Rotate segmented rings to guide a bouncing ball downward.
entries.return_hypothesis: Longer drop chains and level completion.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: 2D angular slices can replace a 3D tower.
entries.original_adaptation: Turn a scrap spiral so a bolt falls through safe gaps.
entries.implementation_brief: Test bounce on safe sectors, hazard contact, continuous drop combo and bottom finish.

entries.name: Color Switch: Endless Play Fun
entries.core_mechanic: Cross moving obstacles only through matching colors.
entries.controls: Tap to rise; timing is inferred from the listing's color-obstacle description.
entries.return_hypothesis: Learning rotating patterns.
entries.difficulty: Matching a changing color while keeping altitude.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: ring-angle collision with shape labels for accessibility.
entries.original_adaptation: Send a patterned spark through matching labeled gates.
entries.implementation_brief: Distinct from Ink Trick: moving spatial barriers. Test mismatched contact and color changes.

entries.name: Paper.io 2
entries.core_mechanic: Leave safe territory, draw a loop, return to capture space.
entries.return_hypothesis: Risk/reward land capture.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: grid flood fill and explicit local AI.
entries.original_adaptation: Reclaim paint squares from visible patrol robots; label AI as local.
entries.implementation_brief: Test enclosed-area flood fill, exposed trail collision and capture goal.

entries.name: Hole.io - Original Hole Game
entries.core_mechanic: Collect small objects to grow enough for larger objects.
entries.return_hypothesis: Size growth unlocks new routes.
entries.difficulty: Choosing feasible objects before a timer expires.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: top-down circles and a spatial grid.
entries.original_adaptation: Guide a recycling hatch through a junkyard; objects have labeled minimum size.
entries.implementation_brief: Test size gate, growth, bounded collection and goal failure; no fake multiplayer.

entries.name: Water Sort Puzzle
entries.core_mechanic: Pour same-color liquid layers into bottles with space.
entries.return_hypothesis: Finding fewer-move solutions.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: small arrays and reverse-generated solvable puzzles.
entries.original_adaptation: Sort labeled coolant layers with undo and a visible capacity.
entries.implementation_brief: Do not duplicate ball sorting: pour contiguous runs, variable layer volumes. Test illegal pour and solvable generation.

entries.name: Ball Sort Puzzle®
entries.core_mechanic: Move only the top colored ball into a compatible tube.
entries.return_hypothesis: Planning tube order.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: discrete stacks and reversible generation.
entries.original_adaptation: Group patterned bolts; one bolt moves per turn, with undo.
entries.implementation_brief: Test top-only move, matching restriction, full tube rejection and completion.

entries.name: Snake.io - Fun Snake .io Games
entries.publisher: Kooapps Games | Fun Arcade and Casual Action Games
entries.core_mechanic: Eat to grow and avoid bodies; source adds arena opponents.
entries.return_hypothesis: A longer cable and efficient routes.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: grid-based local variant avoids online dependence.
entries.original_adaptation: Route a growing cable through repair snacks and wall gates.
entries.implementation_brief: Classic grid snake, not an online imitation. Test growth, no immediate reverse and body collision.

entries.name: Bricks Breaker Quest
entries.core_mechanic: Aim bouncing balls at numbered bricks before they descend.
entries.return_hypothesis: Better bank shots and clearing a stage.
entries.difficulty: Brick hit points and limited turns.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: swept circle/AABB collision with bounded volley count.
entries.original_adaptation: Launch energy pellets into a descending numbered scrap wall.
entries.implementation_brief: The listing is an aim-and-volley format, not evidence for a paddle game. Test bank angle, repeated hits and bottom failure.

entries.name: Knife Hit
entries.core_mechanic: Throw into a spinning target while avoiding attached objects.
entries.return_hypothesis: Completing rotating targets.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: angular intervals and throw travel.
entries.original_adaptation: Rivet a rotating wheel without striking previous rivets.
entries.implementation_brief: Different from Satellite Selfie: successful inputs permanently alter collision space. Test occupied angle and reversal.

entries.name: Traffic Racer
entries.core_mechanic: Drive through traffic while collecting distance and near-miss rewards.
entries.controls: Tilt/touch steering in family; arrows and two touch pedals in adaptation.
entries.return_hypothesis: Cleaner near misses and longer distance.
entries.difficulty: Relative vehicle speed and limited road width.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: top-down continuous steering and traffic gap checks.
entries.original_adaptation: Steer a delivery trike through irregular local traffic with safe spawn gaps.
entries.implementation_brief: Different from Metro: analog steering/braking instead of lane jumps. Test traffic collision and near-miss score once.

entries.name: Basketball Stars: Multiplayer
entries.core_mechanic: Shoot with trajectory control; source has competitive duels and shootouts.
entries.return_hypothesis: A cleaner shooting streak.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: local ballistic shootout; online duel infrastructure deliberately omitted.
entries.original_adaptation: Sink hand-drawn balls through moving rooftop hoops with finite attempts.
entries.implementation_brief: No advertised multiplayer. Test rim bounce, descending hoop crossing and miss accounting.

entries.name: 8 Ball Pool
entries.core_mechanic: Cue shots with ball collision, pockets and turn rules.
entries.return_hypothesis: Position play and accurate shots.
entries.html5_feasibility: High for a small local table; full networking is outside scope.
entries.original_adaptation: Pocket three scrap balls in a short original local puzzle table.
entries.implementation_brief: Implement circle collision, cushion response, pockets and scratch loss; do not reduce it to click targets.

entries.name: Unblock Me
entries.core_mechanic: Slide constrained blocks to clear an exit route.
entries.controls: Drag blocks along their allowed axis.
entries.return_hypothesis: Fewer-move solutions.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: integer grid occupancy and authored solvable boards.
entries.original_adaptation: Move workshop crates so a battery cart reaches the exit.
entries.implementation_brief: Test allowed axis, collision rejection, undo and exact exit recognition.

entries.name: Flow Free
entries.core_mechanic: Join matching endpoints while covering a board without crossings.
entries.return_hypothesis: Efficient complete coverage.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: grid paths and validated authored puzzles.
entries.original_adaptation: Connect patterned power terminals with separate routes.
entries.implementation_brief: Different from Live Wire: multiple mutually exclusive paths plus whole-board coverage. Test crossing rejection and full coverage.

entries.name: Bad Piggies
entries.core_mechanic: Assemble components then simulate a vehicle reaching a destination.
entries.return_hypothesis: Experimenting with different constructions.
entries.html5_feasibility: High but costly: restricted component sockets keep scope finite.
entries.original_adaptation: Choose wheels, motor and balloon positions on a scrap frame, then test delivery.
entries.implementation_brief: Test assembly validation, propulsion, rollover and endpoint; authored original challenge maps.

entries.name: Smash Hit
entries.core_mechanic: Throw projectiles at approaching breakable obstacles.
entries.return_hypothesis: Keeping a resource-rich hit streak.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: projected 2D depth and target sweeps.
entries.original_adaptation: Break paper-glass panes through a reactor tunnel with limited bolts.
entries.implementation_brief: Test ammo spending, obstacle depth hit, barrier collision and ammo pickups.

entries.name: Does not Commute
entries.core_mechanic: Drive sequential routes while earlier drives replay as traffic.
entries.return_hypothesis: Planning a cleaner sequence of routes.
entries.difficulty: Your earlier paths constrain later runs.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: deterministic sampled ghost paths and steering.
entries.original_adaptation: Drive three repair carts; earlier routes replay visibly as local ghosts.
entries.implementation_brief: Not another traffic runner: record/replay must be deterministic. Test ghost collision and cumulative route completion.

entries.name: Alto's Odyssey
entries.core_mechanic: One-touch sandboarding with flips, grinding and trick chains.
entries.controls: Tap jump; hold for rotation (family inference).
entries.return_hypothesis: Longer trick combos.
entries.difficulty: Landing angle and linking terrain features.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: 2D slopes and explicit airborne rotation.
entries.original_adaptation: Board across paper dunes; choose safe jumps or risky flip chains.
entries.implementation_brief: Distinct from Rail Grind: rotation landing and linked score multipliers. Test failed landing angle and combo reset.

entries.name: Duet
entries.core_mechanic: Rotate two linked objects to avoid incoming obstacles.
entries.controls: Hold either screen side to rotate; arrows.
entries.return_hypothesis: Mastering paired geometry.
entries.difficulty: Both opposite objects must remain safe.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: two circle positions derived from one angle.
entries.original_adaptation: Steer linked reactor satellites through asymmetric moving walls.
entries.implementation_brief: Different from timing Orbit Escape: sustained dual-body collision decisions. Test either body hit and opposing holds.

entries.name: Mini Metro
entries.core_mechanic: Draw transit routes and allocate limited vehicles as demand grows.
entries.return_hypothesis: More efficient networks.
entries.difficulty: Demand, transfer paths and limited capacity.
entries.html5_feasibility: High for a small local map; graph routing and queues required.
entries.original_adaptation: Connect rooftop delivery stops with a few cable trams.
entries.implementation_brief: Test graph connectivity, passenger delivery, capacity and overload failure. Keep map bounded for mobile.

entries.name: Super Cat Tales 2
entries.core_mechanic: Touch-focused platform exploration with character abilities.
entries.controls: Two-side movement (inferred from family); adaptation auto-vault plus arrows.
entries.return_hypothesis: Exploring hidden routes.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: authored 2D stages with auto-vault rules.
entries.original_adaptation: Explore original rooftop rooms with an armored squirrel; collect keys to open exit.
entries.implementation_brief: Different from endless jumping: horizontal stage, keys and one-way platforms. Test wall auto-vault and locked exit.

entries.name: PAKO - Car Chase Simulator
entries.core_mechanic: Survive a car chase inside a bounded arena.
entries.return_hypothesis: A longer escape and clever turns.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: bicycle steering and limited predictive AI.
entries.original_adaptation: Escape paint patrol carts in a workshop courtyard.
entries.implementation_brief: Use clear pursuer spawn telegraphs. Test steering inertia, wall collision and pursuer interception.

entries.name: Smashy Road: Wanted
entries.core_mechanic: Vehicle escape through changing environments and escalating pursuit.
entries.return_hypothesis: Finding routes and surviving escalation.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: top-down local version with capped actors.
entries.original_adaptation: A heavy scrap truck breaks light fences but must avoid reinforced barriers.
entries.implementation_brief: Distinct from Scrap Chase through destructible route planning and truck momentum. Test material collision and breach.

entries.name: One More Line
entries.core_mechanic: Grapple nearby nodes, orbit them, release on a new trajectory.
entries.controls: One-button hold/release (mechanic inference from listing presentation).
entries.return_hypothesis: A clean chain of tangential releases.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: analytic orbit plus momentum preservation.
entries.original_adaptation: Thread a courier through hook posts with hold-to-tether movement.
entries.implementation_brief: Different from one-shot Swing Rescue: repeated grapple choices. Test acquisition, tangential release and wall collision.

entries.name: Fishing and Life
entries.core_mechanic: Cast a line and catch fish with simple controls.
entries.return_hypothesis: Finding deeper catches and improving a calm cast.
entries.difficulty: Cast distance, fish movement and lure reach.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: small ballistic cast and hook overlap.
entries.original_adaptation: Catch drifting scrap fish from a painted pier with finite cast attempts.
entries.implementation_brief: Avoid repeating spring landing: reel movement and hook timing determine catch. Test cast, hook, reel and empty cast.

entries.name: Brain It On! - Physics Puzzles
entries.core_mechanic: Draw physical shapes to satisfy a spatial objective.
entries.return_hypothesis: Alternative solutions and efficient shapes.
entries.html5_feasibility: High with point/segment budget; arbitrary geometry needs careful limits.
entries.original_adaptation: Draw a weighted plank to tip a battery into a safe receiver.
entries.implementation_brief: Bound vertex counts; test dynamic shape weight, collision, undo and puzzle condition.

entries.name: Okay?
entries.core_mechanic: Drag a trajectory that clears board elements.
entries.controls: Listing explicitly says drag a line.
entries.return_hypothesis: Finding one clean shot.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: swept collision and deterministic reflection.
entries.original_adaptation: Fire a tuning bolt through original resonant panels; each struck panel contributes a note.
entries.implementation_brief: Different from Comet Curl: multi-target destructive ricochet puzzle, not final stopping position. Test order-independent target clear.

entries.name: Tetris®
entries.core_mechanic: Place and rotate falling blocks to clear completed lines.
entries.return_hypothesis: Better packing and longer survival.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: grid collision and deterministic piece queue.
entries.original_adaptation: Use an original small set of scrap polyforms and original rotation/board design.
entries.implementation_brief: Avoid borrowed branding and presentation. Test wall rotation rejection, line clear, stack overflow and bag fairness.

entries.name: Minesweeper GO - classic game
entries.core_mechanic: Reveal safe cells using adjacent hazard counts; mark suspects.
entries.return_hypothesis: Reasoned solutions and cleaner deduction.
entries.difficulty: Local count constraints and unknown cells.
entries.html5_feasibility: High: small seeded board plus first-click safety.
entries.original_adaptation: Survey a reactor floor for unstable fuses with numbered neighbors and undo before detonation.
entries.implementation_brief: Test first-click safe generation, flood reveal, flags and hazard loss; label guessing if a board lacks proof of deduction.
